turns.match: mock up a checkout page for a bakery
turns.script:
scene layout=caption
look studio
screen x1 | screen co browser theme=light accent=#b5651d radius=soft type=serif density=comfortable | Checkout
row x1 | nav id=co.nav1 in=co links="Breads,Pastries,Cakes,Visit us" action="Cart (3)" | Hearth & Crumb
row x1 | col id=co.col1 in=co gap=l pad=l max=1000 center
row x1 | heading large id=co.heading1 in=co.col1 | Checkout
row x1 | row id=co.row1 in=co.col1 gap=l
row x1 | col id=co.col2 in=co.row1 gap=m pad=l grow card
row x1 | heading small id=co.heading2 in=co.col2 | Pickup or delivery
row x1 | pick id=co.pick1 in=co.col2 | How would you like it? | *Pickup at Elm St* | Local delivery
row x1 | field id=co.field1 in=co.col2 | Full name | Jamie Rivera
row x1 | field id=co.field2 in=co.col2 | Email | jamie@example.com
row x1 | pick id=co.pick2 in=co.col2 | Pickup time | Sat 8:00 | *Sat 9:30* | Sat 11:00
row x1 | field id=co.field3 in=co.col2 | Note for the baker | Please write Happy 7th Birthday, Leo
row x1 | heading small id=co.heading3 in=co.col2 | Payment
row x1 | field id=co.field4 in=co.col2 | Card number | 4242 4242 4242 4242
row x1 | row id=co.row2 in=co.col2 gap=m
row x1 | field id=co.field5 in=co.row2 | Expiry | 08/28
row x1 | field id=co.field6 in=co.row2 | CVC | 123
row x1 | end
row x1 | end
row x1 | col id=co.col3 in=co.row1 gap=m pad=l card lift
row x1 | heading small id=co.heading4 in=co.col3 | Your order
row x1 | item id=co.item1 in=co.col3 value=$6.50 | Country sourdough | 1 loaf
row x1 | item id=co.item2 in=co.col3 value=$14.00 | Butter croissants | Box of 4
row x1 | item id=co.item3 in=co.col3 value=$32.00 | Lemon olive oil cake | 8 inch, message on top
row x1 | divider id=co.divider1 in=co.col3
row x1 | row id=co.row3 in=co.col3 spread
row x1 | text dim id=co.text1 in=co.row3 | Subtotal
row x1 | text id=co.text2 in=co.row3 | $52.50
row x1 | end
row x1 | row id=co.row4 in=co.col3 spread
row x1 | text bold id=co.text3 in=co.row4 | Total
row x1 | price id=co.price1 in=co.row4 | 52.50 | USD
row x1 | end
row x1 | button primary wide id=co.button1 in=co.col3 | Place order
row x1 | note id=co.note1 in=co.col3 | Baked fresh the morning of your pickup.
row x1 | end
row x1 | end
row x1 | end
say x2 | A warm, one-page checkout: order details on the left, basket on the right.
